upstream.source_authority: exact typed upstream identities and clocks; legacy dealing_range metrics, range_position, rejection scores and natural-language annotations are not sources

parameter_basis.threshold_origin: one-time outcome-blind descriptive engineering thresholds; none was selected from PnL, future delivery, action labels, MFE or MAE
parameter_basis.atr_periods: 14 matches the existing causal observer scale and supplies dimensionless H1 width and 1m penetration without a new market-specific unit
parameter_basis.minimum_candidate_real_h1_bars: eight bars permit two non-overlapping four-bar range samples and require persistence beyond a short oscillation
parameter_basis.maximum_forming_real_h1_bars: twenty-four H1 bars bound one forming attempt to approximately one full electronic-session cycle and prevent stale candidates from blocking new source pairs
parameter_basis.minimum_boundary_touches_each: the structural repeat-test standard carried by the typed tested-zone lifecycle: two distinct confirmed swings inside one zone. Since balance_range_v1.2 this is no longer the balance evidence -- balance reads price test generations against the frozen boundary instead
parameter_basis.balance_price_test_band_atr_fraction: fraction of the ATR known before the bar that sizes the boundary tolerance band
parameter_basis.balance_price_test_band_minimum_ticks: floor on that band so a quiet regime still admits a real touch
parameter_basis.balance_deep_penetration_atr_fraction: how far beyond the boundary a test must reach to be classified deep rather than shallow
parameter_basis.balance_minimum_price_test_generations_e: distinct price test generations required on each boundary before the balance claim is published
parameter_basis.minimum_midpoint_crossings: two close-side changes demonstrate a two-sided internal auction rather than one pass through the interval
parameter_basis.minimum_inside_close_fraction: eighty percent requires persistent containment while allowing one descriptive excursion in the minimum eight-bar sample
parameter_basis.maximum_width_atr_at_formation: four formation-time H1 ATRs excludes broad directional areas while allowing a multi-hour balance to form
parameter_basis.compression_windows: the first four and most recent four candidate bars are non-overlapping at first eligibility and remain bounded thereafter
parameter_basis.maximum_compression_ratio: a late-to-early median true-range ratio no greater than 0.80 records a material twenty-percent contraction rather than minor bar noise
parameter_basis.manipulation_resolution: the sweep bar cannot resolve itself; reentry needs one additional inside hold bar, outside acceptance needs two consecutive closes, and unresolved state is censored after five later real completed 1m bars
parameter_basis.retention_limits: memory-safety limits only; they never qualify price structure or trading authority

clock.decision_update: one update per newly completed 1m bar
clock.range_semantic_clock: only ordered real_completed H1 candles may form, mature, age or break a dealing range
clock.manipulation_semantic_clock: only ordered real_completed 1m candles may sweep, age or resolve a manipulation
clock.knowledge_time: every formed_at, mature_at, swept_at, reaccepted_at, accepted_outside_at and broken_at is the completed-bar end when the full evidence first became knowable; no clock is backfilled to a pivot or intrabar extreme
clock.source_visibility: a source is eligible for a completed 1m bar only when its mature_at or confirmed_at is no later than that bar.start and the source was present in the prior successful observation
clock.synthetic: synthetic or partially synthetic candles may advance the raw cutoff but cannot change semantic state, source selection, ATR, strength, age or duration
clock.scheduled_closure: preserve all state; the first later real completed bar continues the lifecycle without charging missing market minutes to semantic age
clock.exact_retry: the same asof, completed-bar provenance and typed-source envelopes return the exact prior committed update; a non-identical input at the same clock is rejected before mutation
clock.out_of_order: a clock earlier than the last committed clock is rejected before mutation

candidate_sources.lower: one H1 SupportResistanceState whose side is support and lifecycle is active or tested
candidate_sources.upper: one H1 SupportResistanceState whose side is resistance and lifecycle is active or tested
candidate_sources.geometry: support.upper_bound < resistance.lower_bound and the selecting completed H1 close lies inside [support.lower_bound, resistance.upper_bound]
candidate_sources.contract: both sources come from the same H1 frame, symbol, instrument_id, uninterrupted epoch, exact Group1-2 protocol hash and tick-size binding
candidate_sources.source_pair_reuse: one ordered support-zone/resistance-zone identity pair is admitted at most once; a terminal range remains source-pinned and ineligible for compaction while both source IDs remain in the authoritative upstream snapshot

candidate_selection.when: only after updating an existing live range; no replacement is allowed while a forming or mature state remains live, and no new candidate is selected on the same H1 bar that terminalizes the prior range
eligible_pair_order: smallest frozen outer width upper_bound minus lower_bound
most recent pair eligibility clock max(lower.confirmed_at, upper.confirmed_at)
candidate_selection.selection_clock: the current real completed H1 candle end
candidate_selection.formed_at: the selection clock, never an earlier source clock
candidate_selection.identity: hash(protocol_hash, symbol, instrument_id, lower_zone_id, upper_zone_id, formed_at)

frozen_geometry.value_semantics: value becomes authoritative only while lifecycle is mature; a forming midpoint is candidate geometry and a broken midpoint is retained historical provenance
frozen_geometry.formation_atr: arithmetic mean of the last 14 positive real-completed H1 true ranges through formed_at, with one real predecessor close and tick_size as the positive floor
frozen_geometry.immutability: source IDs, source clocks, source bounds, range bounds, midpoint, value_price, formation_atr and width_atr_at_formation never change after formed_at

incremental_statistics.candidate_bar_set: real completed H1 candles with end from formed_at through the current H1 end, retained up to maximum_forming_real_h1_bars
incremental_statistics.boundary_touch_counts: the exact total_touch_count of each frozen source zone as known at the current H1 clock; counts freeze at mature_at
incremental_statistics.inside_close_fraction: count(lower_bound <= close <= upper_bound) divided by candidate real H1 bar count
incremental_statistics.midpoint_crossings: remove closes exactly equal to midpoint, encode remaining closes below as -1 and above as +1, then count adjacent sign changes
incremental_statistics.early_true_range: median true range of the first four candidate real H1 bars
incremental_statistics.late_true_range: median true range of the most recent four candidate real H1 bars
incremental_statistics.strength: unweighted mean of narrowness_strength, compression_strength, boundary_test_strength, crossing_strength and inside_close_fraction; descriptive only

break.price_break: a later real completed H1 close strictly below lower_bound or strictly above upper_bound
break.source_break: before the balance claim settles, either frozen source zone ceases to be active or tested
break.deadline: after evaluating price break, source validity and the balance claim on candidate bar 24, a range whose claim has not settled becomes broken with reason maturity_deadline_elapsed
break.equality: a close equal to either frozen bound remains inside
break.wick_only: a high or low outside the range with a completed H1 close inside does not break the range
break.post_settlement_source_retirement: source-zone retirement alone does not rewrite or break a range whose balance claim has settled; only its frozen close rule or a hard epoch boundary does
break.terminal: broken is terminal and preserves all frozen geometry and balance evidence

balance_claim.not_a_transition: settling the balance claim records balance_confirmed_at and transition_reason=balance_claim_confirmed on a range whose lifecycle stays active; the interval was already a location on the bar before
balance_claim.clock: the first real completed H1 end at which every condition is simultaneously true
balance_claim.evidence_change: balance_range_v1.2 replaced the two source zones' structural total_touch_count with price test generations against each frozen boundary. A structural touch only increments when another confirmed swing forms inside the source zone, so over 2022-02 seventeen of eighteen H1 zones stayed at one touch for life and the standard was unreachable in principle. The required count is unchanged at 2; the evidence it reads is different.
balance_claim.freeze_at_settlement: balance_confirmed_at, exact source touch counts and IDs, price test generations per boundary, midpoint crossings, inside fraction, compression ratio, component strengths and aggregate strength
balance_claim.not_strategy_gate: a settled balance claim authorizes only a descriptive dealing-range/value source, and is not FAVR authority

mature_range_boundary.state: a DealingRangeState that was mature in the prior successful observation and remains mature after any current H1 update
mature_range_boundary.boundary: upper_bound for side above or lower_bound for side below
mature_range_boundary.prior_close: the prior real completed 1m close must lie inside the full frozen range
mature_range_boundary.inventory: the exact matching range_boundary inventory item must be visible at bar.start

formed_liquidity_pool.state: the exact Group1-2 LiquidityPoolState formation source was formed in the prior successful observation
formed_liquidity_pool.boundary: upper_bound for an above pool or lower_bound for a below pool
formed_liquidity_pool.prior_close: for above, prior close <= upper_bound; for below, prior close >= lower_bound
formed_liquidity_pool.inventory: the exact matching equal_highs or equal_lows inventory item must be visible at bar.start

source_provenance.immutability: all source provenance and geometry freeze at swept_at
source_provenance.ordinary_wick_rule: a wick without one eligible pre-existing typed source emits no ManipulationState and remains only a candle or generic liquidity description

sweep.above: current real completed 1m high is strictly greater than source upper_bound
sweep.below: current real completed 1m low is strictly less than source lower_bound
sweep.source_clock_rule: source mature_at or confirmed_at <= current 1m bar.start; a source created at current bar.end cannot be swept by that bar
sweep.prior_close_rule: the immediately preceding real completed 1m close must satisfy the source-specific inside rule
sweep.sweep_extreme: current high for above or current low for below, frozen from the first sweep bar and never replaced by a later extreme
sweep.close_outside_on_sweep: whether the sweep bar close remains beyond the swept-side boundary
sweep.penetration_atr: strict penetration distance divided by the frozen 14-real-1m ATR known at bar.start
sweep.identity: hash(protocol_hash, symbol, instrument_id, source_kind, source_id, side, swept_at)

multiple_source_selection.one_side_only: if eligible candidates are crossed on both above and below in the same 1m bar, emit no ManipulationState, consume every crossed inventory item, and emit ambiguous_dual_side_sweep because OHLC cannot prove event order
multiple_source_selection.primary_source: when one side has multiple crossed eligible sources, select the boundary with the smallest nonnegative distance from the prior real 1m close
multiple_source_selection.coincident_sources: store the IDs of exact same-price tied eligible sources as coincident_source_ids, but emit one manipulation identity and never double-count their evidence

resolution.earliest: the sweep bar never resolves itself. REACCEPTED can first complete on the second later real completed 1m bar: the first inside close creates the candidate and the immediately following inside close supplies the one-bar hold. ACCEPTED_OUTSIDE can complete on the first later real completed 1m bar only when the sweep close and that immediately following real close are both outside; otherwise it completes on the second close of a later consecutive outside pair.
resolution.upper_boundary_reaccepted: after an above-side pool or mature-range-boundary sweep, the first candidate close is <= the frozen swept upper boundary and one further real completed close must remain there
resolution.upper_boundary_accepted_outside: after an above-side sweep, two consecutive closes strictly above the frozen upper boundary are accepted outside; the sweep close counts as the first when applicable
resolution.lower_boundary_reaccepted: after a below-side pool or mature-range-boundary sweep, the first candidate close is >= the frozen swept lower boundary and one further real completed close must remain there
resolution.lower_boundary_accepted_outside: after a below-side sweep, two consecutive closes strictly below the frozen lower boundary are accepted outside; the sweep close counts as the first when applicable
resolution.reentry_price: the first candidate reentry close, frozen after the later hold bar confirms reaccepted; null for accepted_outside
resolution.reentry_failure: an outside close before confirmation clears the candidate, records reentry_failed_at, and restarts the outside run
resolution.deadline: if neither outcome resolves after five later real completed 1m bars, retain lifecycle swept and set deadline_elapsed, deadline_at and censored_at to the actual fifth real-bar clock; deadline_at is null beforehand because gaps and closures make that clock unknowable at sweep time; synthetic bars do not count and a terminal outcome on the fifth real bar takes precedence
resolution.outside_completed_bars: count of the sweep bar and later real completed 1m bars whose closes satisfy the source-specific outside rule through resolution
resolution.duration: real completed 1m bars and event-memory market minutes from swept_at through resolved_at or censored_at; synthetic and scheduled-closure minutes are excluded
resolution.terminal: reaccepted and accepted_outside are terminal; later extrema and closes cannot rewrite the result

same_1m_bar_priority: advance or resolve an already-swept manipulation from the completed close
apply any current real completed H1 range transition
if an older manipulation resolved on this bar, do not create another manipulation
select at most one new manipulation from prior-visible sources that remain eligible
create new range-boundary inventory after maturity, with no same-bar sweep
manipulation.source_generation: one source inventory identity may create at most one manipulation; the source inventory becomes consumed on its first crossing, so a later attempt requires a new range identity, range-boundary identity or liquidity-pool generation rather than a separate tombstone

range_boundary_inventory.creation: a mature range emits exactly two LiquidityInventoryItem values after the maturity transition commits
range_boundary_inventory.source_ids: range_id plus the corresponding source zone_id
range_boundary_inventory.crossing: a prior-visible above item is consumed by high > price; a prior-visible below item is consumed by low < price; equality does not consume
range_boundary_inventory.consumed_at: the first crossing real completed 1m end
range_boundary_inventory.independence: range break does not retrospectively remove or consume the opposite unswept boundary; its inventory lifecycle remains a separate record of visible versus consumed liquidity
range_boundary_inventory.current_bar_rule: confirmed_at <= current 1m bar.start is required, so maturity and consumption cannot occur from the same completed bar

cold_attach.dealing_range: never infer a current range from one current S/R snapshot. Replay ordered real H1 candles with their exact Group1-2 typed zone snapshots from no later than the candidate selection clock, plus one predecessor and the 14-real-H1 ATR prefix. If unavailable, mark already-present source pairs ineligible until at least one source ID changes and wait for a fresh pair
cold_attach.manipulation: for every eligible mature range boundary or formed pool, the retained real completed 1m prefix must begin no later than source eligibility and include one predecessor plus the 14-real-1m ATR prefix; reconstruct the first strict crossing and replay every later real bar through candidate, hold, outside-run and deadline state up to the prefix cutoff
cold_attach.inventory: the same prefix reconstructs each range boundary's first crossing. A prefix beginning after confirmed_at cannot prove visibility and fails closed rather than declaring the boundary unswept
cold_attach.checkpoint: a hash-bound checkpoint containing the exact Group4 state and last committed source envelope resumes directly without rediscovery
cold_attach.partial_recovery: failure to reconstruct any one retained source rejects the entire cold attachment; partial range, manipulation or inventory projection is forbidden

soft.scheduled_maintenance_or_weekend: preserve forming, mature and swept states; do not change semantic age, duration, ATR, compression or source selection
soft.synthetic_or_partially_synthetic_candle: advance raw cutoff only; do not form, mature, break, sweep, resolve, compact or age state

boundaries.dealing_range_terminalization: forming or mature becomes broken at the boundary clock with the exact hard reason; frozen geometry and source provenance remain unchanged
boundaries.manipulation_censorship: a swept manipulation is not relabeled as market acceptance. It remains lifecycle swept in a dedicated typed boundary transition, sets censored_at to the boundary clock and transition_reason to the exact hard reason, then leaves the new epoch
boundaries.event_memory: ordinary old-epoch Group4 transitions do not enter the new epoch's EventMemory; same-clock hard-boundary range terminals and manipulation censorship are exposed in dedicated typed boundary fields and persisted in the replay row
boundaries.contract_isolation: new-epoch frames and ordinary state contain only the new symbol and instrument_id; no source identity crosses the boundary

minimum_state: one live H1 range candidate and at most 24 candidate H1 bars
the prior real completed 1m close and two 14-bar ATR windows
incremental_state_capacity_and_transacti.no_full_history_scan: normal updates use only prior committed state, the current completed 1m bar, optional newly completed H1 candle and exact upstream transition envelopes
incremental_state_capacity_and_transacti.eviction: live state is never evicted. Only terminal state whose terminal transition appeared in an earlier successful observation may be compacted; a terminal range remains pinned while both frozen source zone IDs remain in the authoritative upstream snapshot, and manipulation reuse is prevented by its consumed source-inventory identity
incremental_state_capacity_and_transacti.same_bar_terminal_exposure: a same-bar terminal transition remains visible in that successful observation; bounded overflow equals at most the number of same-bar terminals and is compacted before the next real semantic update
incremental_state_capacity_and_transacti.capacity_exhaustion: if safe compaction cannot admit required new state, reject the entire completed-bar update rather than changing thresholds, evicting live state or growing without bound
incremental_state_capacity_and_transacti.transaction: range state, manipulation state, source-eligibility bookkeeping and range-boundary inventory additions/consumptions are updated in one shadow copy and committed once. Any exception leaves the prior clock, state, ATR, candidate window, ages, inventory and histories unchanged
incremental_state_capacity_and_transacti.paired_observer_failure: if a later observer or EventMemory projection fails after upstream or Group4 state committed, discard that observer and resume from the last checkpoint; never reuse partially paired state

event_memory_and_consumers.range_timeline: range:<range_id> records forming, mature and broken with event time, duration, age, strength, frozen geometry, source IDs and transition reason
event_memory_and_consumers.manipulation_timeline: manipulation:<manipulation_id> records swept then reaccepted, accepted_outside or deadline-censored; hard-boundary censorship uses only the typed boundary channel
event_memory_and_consumers.observation: H1 exposes typed dealing-range state; top-level current state exposes completed-1m manipulations and authoritative range-boundary inventory without rewriting the H1 cutoff
event_memory_and_consumers.visualization: draw frozen H1 bounds and midpoint/value, manipulation sweep extreme, outside duration, reentry price and source IDs without expanding the price axis
event_memory_and_consumers.brain: Group4 outputs are descriptive inputs only. Consumers must require typed identity and lifecycle and may not reconstruct them from legacy metrics
event_memory_and_consumers.future_reveal: future candles remain physically separate and cannot change any Group4 identity, clock, geometry or lifecycle

playbook_authority.failed_auction_value_return: implemented but runtime parked because mature-range coverage is sparse and no complete identity-bound natural FAVR chain was observed
playbook_authority.no_trade_authority: Group4 emits typed descriptive range, manipulation and range-boundary inventory state but never selects an action, stop, target, risk result or execution outcome. Typed playbooks may consume its frozen identities and lifecycles through their own causal gates; FAVR remains runtime parked
playbook_authority.later_requirement: FAVR may be reconsidered only after an identity-bound natural mature-range, manipulation, opposite displacement, qualified zone, first-pullback and trigger chain is observed. Group4 remains the sole owner of range-boundary sweep and multi-bar reacceptance

formalization_gate.repair_limit: after implementation, at most one concept-level repair; a second systematic semantic failure parks Group4 or the affected primitive instead of tuning thresholds
